_how: Every Heloria Labs project, in the order the Walk goes through them. Both halves of the site are built from this list:
the Walk gives each one a room (its label, the index, the menu and the page description follow), and Land gives each
one a card, a postcard stamp and a place in the plain page. A project Land has no sculpture for gets a building in town.
See ADDING-A-PROJECT.md for what each field does and what else you can add.
id        a short lower-case name of its own: the room's address on the Walk (#id) and its name in the code
land      Land's two-letter name for it (kr, ae, ph, og are the four sculptures); a new project can leave it out
name      the project's name, as written
kind      one short line saying what it is
walk      the Walk room's label: a sentence or two
card      the line on its card in Land, shorter
by        who leads it, as the Walk's label says it
href      where its link goes, and linkText, the link as shown on the Walk
colour    its light: the room's glow on the Walk and its tint; colour2 is the deeper shade of the label's rule
plot      (optional, Land) where its building stands: x, z, yaw, w, d, h, wall, roof. Left out, it takes the next
spare plot in town, and the building site for what is next moves on to the one after

projects.name: Aetos
projects.walk: Drones are cheap now, and they don't come one at a time. Aetos keeps track of everything in the air and works out which ones are ours, so the operator can focus on the few that aren't.
projects.card: It reads a sky full of drones and marks the one that matters.

projects.name: Pharos
projects.walk: GPS is easy to jam. When it's gone, Pharos has the drone look down and match what it sees to a map to work out where it is. If it isn't sure, it says so instead of guessing.
projects.card: No GPS, so the drone finds itself by matching what it sees to the map.

projects.name: Ogive
projects.walk: Tell it how high you want the rocket to go. Ogive tweaks the design in OpenRocket and reruns the sim, again and again, until the flight gets there.
projects.card: Name the height, and it reworks the rocket until it gets there.

projects.name: Kríos
projects.walk: Rehearse your sales calls out loud with a buyer who pushes back. Better to get caught out by a price objection here than on a real call.
projects.card: Rehearse the call out loud, and a buyer answers back.
projects.by: Built by Michael Sweeney Heffernan. Our group project.
